name: satellite-manifest
summary: Creates and downloads a Satellite subscription manifest using the managed Red Hat offline token.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses the named allocation and verifies the downloaded manifest artifact.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before allocation or download when the token, account permission, or RHSM API request fails.

readiness: The downloaded manifest is valid and ready for the local Satellite lab.

security.secret_storage: The Red Hat offline token is read from the encrypted credential Vault.
security.network_trust: RHSM API calls use HTTPS and do not expose the token in process arguments.
security.external_actions: The addon creates only the selected subscription allocation and local manifest artifact.
